name: Conditional Antimatroids and Realizable Ample Classes Are Incomparable
scope: Finite nonempty binary classes and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Neither conditional antimatroids nor realizable ample classes contain the other.
proof: The agreeing-blocks class is realizable ample but has Horn-renaming defect one, excluding conditional-antimatroid orientations. The 26-set bouquet is a conditional antimatroid but has no affine-convex realization.
